notes.notes:
http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/patchnotebanner.png
Patch Notes December 15, 2015
Please note: Details are subject to change at any time.
Weekly Maintenance Time: 6pm-10pm PST (~4 hours)

http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/kafrashop.png
http://i.imgur.com/aJ7XkQE.pngDecember's VIP Packs have arrived!
December Gold Membership Pack
Available December 15 to January 11
Price: 900 Kafra Points

December Platinum Membership Pack
Available December 15 to January 11
Price: 2000 Kafra Points

http://i.imgur.com/kMtHjbj.pngYule be sorry if you miss this new Mount Box!
Yule Festival Mount Box
Available December 15 to January 11
Price: 300 Kafra Points

http://i.imgur.com/SWqMB4j.pngIntroducing Diamond Currency!
Cheny's Diamond Pocket (1013)
Price: 500 Kafra Points

Cheny's Diamond Pocket (2194)
Price: 1,000 Kafra Points

Cheny's Diamond Basket (6992)
Price: 3,000 Kafra Points

Cheny's Diamond Basket (12291)
Price: 5,000 Kafra Points

Cheny's Diamond Basket (26776)
Price: 10,000 Kafra Points

Please Note: Diamonds can also be earned in-game through quests and events. Please visit the Cheny's Secret Shop guide for more information.

http://i.imgur.com/9Vt85y2.png
A complete guide to the Winter 2015 Update's features can be found here.
Mysterious NPC Cheny
The mysterious Cheny is a descendant of Khara. Some time ago, she decided to follow Khara's steps through Midgard. In her travels she met the Dvergr-- an ancient race of ground-dwelling dwarves. Cheny offered her help to the Dvergr, and in return she received a special pet Leprechaun.

Cheny has returned to Prontera with her new friend, Leprechaun, and the two are working together to collect Diamonds for her next journey.

Cheny's Secret Shop contains a collection of items that she has curated throughout her travels. These items will change from time to time. Leprechaun is using his magic to help Cheny collect diamonds. Visit the Leprechaun to learn more about Transmogrification!

Cheny and Leprechaun are located in SW Prontera, in the Graham Arena:
http://i.imgur.com/5uFfwgs.jpg

Please visit the Official Guide to Cheny's Secret Shop for more information!

Transmogrification
Armor and certain weapons can now change their appearance through Transmogrification! This new item allows you to keep the stats of your base item, but exchange its image with another item of the same type.

Target item will retain its stats, refinement, sockets, and honing. The appearance item will be consumed in the process.

Items must share the same type to be transmogrified (Example: Cloth chest armor to cloth chest armor).

Transmogrification requires Diamonds and Zeny as payment. Transmogrification is performed by Leprechaun, located near Cheny in the Graham Arena of Prontera. 

Please visit the Transmogrification Official Guide for more information!

Transmogrification Items
Four new sets of Transmogrification items have been added for Human characters, and one new set has been added for Noel characters. These Transmogrification items have four individual pieces each so sets can be mixed, matched, or used with other armor appearances to make your outfit unique! These items are obtainable from Cheny's Snowflake boxes.

Furious Goblin (M) and Convicted Goblin (F)
http://i.imgur.com/664Y5kn.gifhttp://i.imgur.com/WUxmMpr.gif

Oriental Night (M) and Oriental Morning (F)
http://i.imgur.com/t8I8Kyo.gifhttp://i.imgur.com/w1lIamB.gif

Purified Flame (M) and Judged Flame (F)
http://i.imgur.com/Le0Xcj2.gifhttp://i.imgur.com/cA2MWmg.gif

Tropic Protector (M) and Tropic Destroyer (F)
http://i.imgur.com/HhCGwNg.gifhttp://i.imgur.com/GupuVZY.gif

Noel Set: Star Clown (M) and Moon Clown (F)
http://i.imgur.com/pna5klF.gifhttp://i.imgur.com/IpyYltA.gif

Multi-Dye System
The existing Dye system has gotten a makeover! New costumes can take different dyes in up to three different areas. Please visit the Multi-Dye System guide for more information!

Preview:
http://i.imgur.com/05L6CVE.gif

2nd Episode Dungeon
Join a young Dr. Jacob as he learns the secret of the Wolves Cave! Daily quests associated with solo dungeons can be found at Maden in Bouquet Town, East Mt. Mjolnir. The dungeon can be accessed by pressing "N" to reach the Find Dungeon menu. Check the box for Ep. 2 Hidden Report and off you go!
http://i.imgur.com/1RU8gd9.jpg

Visit the Episode 2: Wolves Cave Guide for more information!

Attendance Calendar Update
The daily attendance calendar has updated! You can now receive Diamonds on Day 7, Day 14, and Day 21. If you log in without missing days, you'll receive double the Diamonds on golden-marked days!
http://i.imgur.com/fy2e4rd.gif

Please Note there has been a chance:
(7 day) will be a Seal of Vulcan
(14 day) will be a Seal of Veriel
(21 day) will be a Seal of Hoenheim
(28 day) will be a Seal of Demeter

Perfect Attendance Reward will be changing as well: 
http://i.imgur.com/vJDn0N8.png

Welcome Santa and the Yule Festival!
Event Period: December 15 - January 18
In order to celebrate the Yule Festival, Santa Claus is busy preparing gift boxes for children.

Unfortunately, after a sudden surprise attack from monsters, all of Santa's gifts lost their wrapping paper!

In order to assist Santa, help him get rid of the monsters that attacked him and take back the stolen Wrapping Papers.

You can donate Wrapping Paper, or exchange with certain items from Santa Claus in Prontera (next to Myunel).

If donated Wrapping Papers reach a certain amount, Santa will start to sell Upgraded Buff Items!

Santa's Exchange List:
http://i.imgur.com/eZHaY67.png

Use a Santa Poring Warp Scroll to enter the new event dungeon! The scroll has a 6 hour cooldown once used.
http://i.imgur.com/EcV1R3O.png

Items from Santa Claus's vendor list:
http://i.imgur.com/Fxz4NHC.png

Get a Santa Poring's Gift Box for a chance to drop one of these items:
http://i.imgur.com/2EoHO5V.png

http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Bugfixes.png

Heal over time skills will no longer display as damage over time in any circumstance 
War of Emperium's Immunity buff will now be immune to damage, area of effect damage, crowd control, and stun. Players with an active immunity buff will not be able to use food, potions, or item buffs. If a player uses a skill or moves while having the buff, it will be removed. Players entering the WoE map with Urgent Recall will receive the Immunity Buff.

Players entering the WoE map with Urgent Recall will receive the Immunity Buff.

notes.notes:
http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/patchnotebanner.png
Patch Notes October 26, 2015
Please note: Details are subject to change at any time.
Weekly Maintenance Time: Monday 3pm- 10pm PST (~7 hours)

http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Changes.png
http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/Servermerge.jpg
Worlds will collide on October 26th! 
FAQs
1. What is going to happen?
On October 26th, 2015 during maintenance, Freya will be merging into Odin.   

2. What about the economies for both servers?
We are using a 1:50 exchange ratio for zeny for Freyja players merging into Odin. This means that a Freyja character will retain 2% of their zeny after the merge. This also applies to guild zeny.

This is based on monitoring both economies. We want to blend the two economies without causing the inflation in Freyja to cause economic damage to Odin’s market.

Resell value of NPC vendor items will be reduced from 10% to 1% permanently. This is to avoid reselling items to get past the exchange rate.

3. What about guild housing?
Guild Housing will be doubled from 16 Houses to 32 Houses, and Freyja Guilds that hold houses at the time of the merge will keep their house on Odin after the merge.

4. What will happen to the War of Emperium Castle and Fortress ownership?
Ownership will be reset on Odin during the October 26th merge.

5. What about the auction house? 
Freyja's auction house will be closed on October 14th, in preparation for the merge. 

6. What about my mail?
Freyja's mail will not be transferred, so make sure you pull all your valuables out of your mailbox prior to the October 26 maintenance!

7. What about my character slots?
Players can have up to 20 character slots taken after the merge, depending on how many total characters they had during the merge.

For example, if a player has 10 Odin characters and 10 Freyja characters, they will keep 20 after the merge. Players will not be able to make more than 10 characters, and if they delete any characters they will not be able to make another character to regain that slot.

Pirate Arrrrt Contest!
http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/ArtContest_small.jpg
Avast ye mateys!  There be an art contest on the horizon.   

From Sept. 9th to the 16th we will be searching the high seas for some creative Pirate themed art to celebrate our fun Pirate adventures in game!

Five lucky winners will be featured in the Ragnarok Online 2 loading screen, but fear not. Even if you don't win, for just sharing your extraordinary talent we will be giving away 5 phantom stone per player.   

Rules that apply: 
1. Must be pirate themed or high seas themed. 
2. Must be a part of the Ragnark Online 2 Universe.
3. Must be original art by the artist.  Cannot be a screenshot or someone else's art.
 4. Can be in various mediums however the final submission will need to be digital. So if you are doing an acrylic painting please scan it and post.  
6. Formats for the art need to be in either DDS, PSD, or Jpeg.
7. They must also be 1920 x 1080 px.  If they are larger they will get cropped or resized.
8. You may post your submission on the forums or if you are feeling shy you may send them to cmvaritas@gmail.com but make sure that the subject line reads "Pirate Art Contest 2015" and your forum name. 
 
Once the submissions have come in and the contest closes, we will go ahead and create a form so that everyone may vote.  That's it!
 
We hope you have fun and don't be shy.  Scribbles on Parchment work too.
Arrrrrr!
 

Monster Beauty Contest!
http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/Monsterbanner2.jpg
Event Period: September 1 - September 15, 2015
 
Ragnarok Online 2 invites you to help us choose the next additions to the shop.   All you have to do is click on the nifty banner above.  We'll see who was the most popular monster of all, and when the time comes we will try to get these fantastic items in the shop for you. 

Don't be afraid to choose multiple choices when it comes to your favorite monster.  We know sometimes it's just so hard to choose.

6. Formats for the art need to be in either DDS, PSD, or Jpeg.
7. They must also be 1920 x 1080 px.  If they are larger they will get cropped or resized.
8. You may post your submission on the forums or if you are feeling shy you may send them to cmvaritas@gmail.com but make sure that the subject line reads "Pirate Art Contest 2015" and your forum name. 
 
Once the submissions have come in and the contest closes, we will go ahead and create a form so that everyone may vote.  That's it!
 
We hope you have fun and don't be shy.  Scribbles on Parchment work too.

WarpPortal welcomes Ragnarok 2 players from Thailand!

 

We are excited to have players from Thailand's Ragnarok 2 joining us on our international server, Freyja, later this month. The community of Ragnarok Online 2 continues to grow in exciting ways with the addition of new players!

 

We hope you will quickly create bonds of friendship that span the globe!

 

FAQ:

Q: When will I be able to opt-in to merge my characters from TH RO2 to iRO2?

A: TH RO2 will have an in-game opt-in method on July 7. On July 28, their service will close. On July 30, we will merge TH RO2 players that opted in via the in-game method into iRO2.

 

Q: Will there be a method to opt-in to merge after TH RO2 is closed?

A: Yes! There will be an opt-in website page for TH RO2 players to opt-in after it closes that is expected to run until October 7.

 

Q: What sort of items will not be merged into iRO2 from TH RO2?

A: Players will  be unable to bring over guilds, mail, kafra cash, and auctions.

 

Update:

We will also be restricting any unique items that only existed on TH RO2 and do not exist in Warpportal's RO2.

We will also be restricting how much zeny characters can come over with.

If you have up to 50,000 zeny, you may keep it.

If you have 50,001-170,000 zeny, you will keep 50,000.

If you have above 170,000 zeny, you will keep 30% of your zeny.

 

http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Bugfixes.png

 

- Dapara's Weekend 500% Weekend EXP was not intended to run outside of Dapara's EXP week. We have detained Dapara for questioning, and the weekend EXP boost should go back to 200%.

notes.notes:
http://blog.warpportal.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/patchnotes.png
Patch Notes for 2/23/2015
Please note: Details are subject to change at any time.
Weekly Maintenance Time: 5 pm PST (~4 hours)
 
Event Update
Weekday EXP boost up event has ended. Dapara event items will be removed. Weekend EXP boosts will remain in effect.
 
Bug Fix & Changes

Forgotten Payon Boss Monster Imoogi will be taken out of the game temporarily while he works on improving his aquatic combat.
Last Valentine's Event's Chocolate Cake and this year's Chocolate Cake shared the same name. Last year’s item is changing to “Old Chocolate Cake”.
The item “List of Prey” is a consumable, but didn’t say so. This is will be corrected.
The bar wouldn’t fill while crafting. This will be fixed so it does fill as you craft.
New Year Event: Costume Box, Accessory Box, and Set effect require localization.
Brutal Strike did not use any Beast Power if it damages more than one enemy. It will use beast power now.
Some overhead objects such as the entrance pagoda, block off character name info in Forgotten Payon. This will be fixed.
Wearing the Traditional Oriental Dress created a "twisted arm" visual bug that will be fixed.
Equipment with no durability does not have an indicator. Indicator will return.
Character Name Change scroll gave players a 60 day cool down on changing names. This will be changed to 14 day cool down time.

notes.title: 9/13 Hotfix
notes.notes:
We pushed out a patch today that will address the following issues:
 
1. Large Hay Stacks in WoE Map are resized to normal.
2. Certain costumes/accessories not working on the Noel class has been fixed.
 
We are aware of many of the other issues that came with the patch, or have been ongoing from previously, and the studio is working on implementing a fix for those in the future. We made the decision to send out this patch before the studio left for the weekend.
 
We apologize for the impromptu patch, if it caught some of you off guard, but we wanted to make sure we got some fixes in before the weekend.

notes.title: 9/11 Maintenance Steam Update
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone.

This patch we attempted to upload a new client so that Steam would update your client and you wouldn't have to sit through the patcher's downloading process. We ran into an error this morning, and could not go through with that method. Instead, we suggest you utilize the manual patch to download the 1.6GB patch files if you don't want to wait for the patcher.

Link: http://playragnarok2.com/news/article/122

You'll want to take the RTP files and drop them into the "Patches" folder in your RO2 directory. From there, there is only a small patch that fixes some bugs and sound issues.

We apologize for getting this news to you so late, if we had known sooner we would've let you know about the manual patch sooner.

We hope to see you in the new zone, leveling as a Noel!

Instead, we suggest you utilize the manual patch to download the 1.6GB patch files if you don't want to wait for the patcher.

Link: http://playragnarok2.com/news/article/122

You'll want to take the RTP files and drop them into the "Patches" folder in your RO2 directory. From there, there is only a small patch that fixes some bugs and sound issues.

We apologize for getting this news to you so late, if we had known sooner we would've let you know about the manual patch sooner.

We hope to see you in the new zone, leveling as a Noel!

notes.title: New Events coming for the Noel patch on 9/11!
notes.notes:
We have several new events and activities starting with the upcoming patch. Check them out:

http://playragnarok2.com/news/article/116

We have a brand new event, inspired by Talk Like a Pirate Day on September 19, with a new quest line to find Captain Morgan and his treasure, as well as a new costume and head accessory that drops off of an old, pirate-themed boss you may all be familiar with.

http://playragnarok2.com/news/article/119
Date: 9/11-9/25
Monsters around your same level will have a chance to drop Union Point Boxes that will give 10 points to a random Union. Also, Union costumes now can be fused up to three rune hole slots.

notes.title: *Complete* Patch Notes (6/12/13)
notes.notes:
*Complete* June 12, 2013 Ragnarok 2 Patch Notes

1. Kafra Shop
A.	 Following items will be removed from the shop
i. VIP Package (Poring name tag version)
ii. VIP Membership card (1 Day) (Poring name tag version)
iii. Premium Mount Box II
iv. Petit
v. Munil’s Costume Random Box I
vi. Munil’s Accessory random box II
B.	 ‘MD Recommended’ changed to ‘WP Recommended’ / Icon MD was also changed to WP
C.	 Used period for VIP item will be shown in Kafra Shop description.

2. Phantom Cape and Hero Cape can be fused
Following items are acquirable upon fusion:
-	 Angel Wings
-	 Devil Wings
-	 Santa Wings
-	 Santa Bag
-	 Hero Cape
-	 Phantom Cape

3. Items sold during the beta can be fused.
Following items are acquirable upon fusion:
-	 Snorkle
-	 Santa Hat
-	 Santa Wings
-	 Santa Rudolph
-	 Santa Bag
-	 Beach Memory
-	 Vacance
-	 Santa for Man
-	 Santa Lady
4.	 Localization fixes have been implemented.
5.	 Character location info has been added to Character selection screen.
6.	 Rewards system timer has been adjusted to center of window.
7.	 Option to toggle own name, VIP effects, guild, and titles has been added.
8.	 Map Auto-Close bug when talking to an NPC has been fixed.
9.	 The issue that caused players to zone into the Colosseum and immediately die has been resolved.
10. Additional server checks have been implementing for players who were being disconnected when changing zones. This should reduce the chance a player can be disconnected while changing zones.

notes.title: Update on Costumes (6/5/13)
notes.notes:
For this week, we will still provide Munil's Costume Random Box I on the Kafra Shop.

This means that the Recruit, Wedding Dress, and Tuxedo costumes will be available for another week, and those costumes will have their stat boosts.

The new Munil's Costume Random Box II will also be in game as well, and provide the new costumes.

Bonus stats will disappear if you use the Recruit, Wedding Dress, or Tuxedo costumes in the fusion system.

notes.title: Patch Notes (5/14/13)
notes.notes:
Ragnarok 2 Patch Notes (May 14, 2013)
Extended Maintenance: 8pm-2am PDT

System

1. Colosseum Update : Open hours will be 1:00pm and 6:00pm PDT
2. Public Chat channel returns and is available for characters at level 15.

Item

1. Black Label and White Messenger mounts enabled
2. Pandora’s Mallet was removed from Colosseum reward item

Mounts

1. Petit mount has been added.

Kafra Shop

1. Petit random Box [Premium Mount Box II] has been released
2. 30 days Petit has been released


Character name filtering

1. Character name filtering file was updated

Bug Fix
1. Slow HP/SP update in the screen has been fixed.
2. Players stuck in certain areas have been fixed. (PhysX logic was changed to prevent character being stuck)
3. Mouse left button clicked state after returning from minimizing the client has been fixed.
4. Monsters sometimes not attacking or moving when the player is hiding behind an object has been fixed.
